messages:
Connor O'Brien: Draft internal announcement for Usage Insights beta + dogfooding request (please reply w/ edits). Planning to post EOD tomorrow.

---
:mega: *Upcoming beta: Usage Insights (Cost drivers by route + model) in Console*

We’re getting close to enabling a limited beta of *Usage Insights* — a new Console view that helps customers (and us) answer:
• What routes are costing the most?
• Which models drive spend on those routes?
• What changed week-over-week?

*What’s included in the beta*
• Route list w/ spend ranking + filters (time range, env, region, org/project, deployment mode)
• Route detail w/ model breakdown + deltas vs prior period
• CSV + JSON export (bounded) with audit logging

*Dogfooding ask (Redwood org only)*
We need internal folks to kick the tires in staging this week — especially export + route tagging + “Unknown route” handling.

1) Go to Console staging: https://console.staging.redwoodinference.com/insights/usage (needs VPN)
2) Enable flag: `usage_insights_beta` (instructions below)
3) Make a few test requests with `route` set (SDK option or header) so we see non-"Unknown" routes
4) Try export for 24h + 7d windows and sanity-check numbers

*Route tagging quickstart*
• TS SDK: `client.responses.create({ ..., route: "api/chat" })`
• Python SDK: `client.responses.create(..., route="api/chat")`
• Header fallback: `x-redwood-route: api/chat`

*Docs (WIP)*
• Overview + FAQ: https://docs.staging.redwoodinference.com/console/usage-insights
• Route naming guidance: https://docs.staging.redwoodinference.com/console/usage-insights#route-tagging
• Export schema + limits: https://docs.staging.redwoodinference.com/console/usage-insights#exports

*Feedback*
• Drop comments in this thread (screenshots welcome)
• Or file Linear under ENG-8426/8427/8425 with label `usage-insights-dogfood`

*Known caveats (beta)*
• Data freshness: expect up to ~30–60 min lag depending on pipeline/backfill
• Invoice reconciliation: route totals may not line up 1:1 with invoice totals (timing/rounding/late events)
• Cardinality guardrails: very high-card routes may roll up to `other` or be truncated

Flag instructions:
• In staging, open `?ff=usage_insights_beta` (temporary) OR ping #eng-platform for a user override

Thanks all — we’d love feedback by Fri so we can stay on track for GA.
---

Paula Mendes: +1. Small tweak: can we say “data freshness up to 2h in worst case” to cover late-arriving metering? We don’t want people to assume it’s always <60m.

Marissa Cole: Also would love to call out *who this is for* internally (FinOps / Support / SEs). Dogfooding from those groups would be ideal.

Dylan Brooks: Re the flag instructions — `?ff=` is only wired up on a couple pages. For this one, it should work, but might be safer to say “open the Feature Flags panel in staging (top-right) and toggle usage_insights_beta”.

Logan Wright: For route tagging snippet, can we *lead* with the SDK param and keep header as “advanced”? We really want people to use the param so normalization is consistent.

Nadia Rahman: Minor: header is `X-Redwood-Route` (case-insensitive but docs should be consistent). Also max length is 120 after normalization; anything longer gets truncated. I’d mention that briefly so people don’t paste full URLs.

Allison Grant: SRE note: please add “if export job fails or times out, include export job id from the toast” — makes debugging way faster.

Elliot Price: Links look good. The docs URLs are correct but the export section anchor is `#export-reports` not `#exports` (I can add a redirect, but better to fix the link).

Monica Patel: TS/Python examples are close but exact method names differ depending on endpoint. For the announcement, maybe keep it abstract:
`route` option on all requests (chat/generate/embeddings). We can link to SDK docs pages that have the precise code.

Kevin Osei: Audit logging callout: maybe add a line: “Exports are audit-logged (who/when/filters) and visible in Org Audit Logs.” That’s a nice selling point + gets internal folks to check it.

Tessa Morgan: Design note: can we specify “route” is a logical *app route* (e.g., `support/chat`) not HTTP URL paths. Helps avoid `/:userId` mistakes.

Amara Diallo: If anyone is testing gateway-derived routes, please ping me. There’s a corner where `Unknown route` can spike if the gateway header is stripped by a proxy. Would love a repro in staging.

Leila Farouk: QA perspective: can we add a checklist at the bottom? (route list loads, filters apply, pagination works, export CSV columns present, route detail deltas match prior period). Helps folks give structured feedback.

SecurityBot: :shield: Reminder: If sharing screenshots, please blur customer/org identifiers. Staging still contains real-like data for some test orgs.

Connor O'Brien: Super helpful. I’ll incorporate:
• freshness wording (up to 2h worst-case)
• explicit ask for Support/SE/FinOps dogfood
• feature flag toggle path (top-right panel)
• fix docs anchors
• audit log mention + export job id note
• “route is logical app route” + length guidance

If anyone has strong opinions on the final wording, reply today; otherwise I’ll post the final announcement tomorrow morning.

Marissa Cole: :thumbsup: maybe also add 1 line: “If you see `Unknown route` dominating, it means you’re not tagging route — link to route tagging section.” That’s the #1 confusion.

Connor O'Brien: done. Will add that as a callout.

Allison Grant: :thumbsup: (and pls include the slack channel for issues: #eng-sre for export failures, #devex for SDK route tagging questions)

Connor O'Brien: good call, adding.
